// diagnostic E0955

Jet.ComptimeFileUnreadable

Comptime file input missing / unreadable (`embed_file` also: not UTF-8)

What

Comptime file input missing / unreadable (`embed_file` also: not UTF-8)

Why

A compile-time file input is read while building, so the file must exist and be readable

Fix

Provide a readable UTF-8 file at the comptime path.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.ComptimeFileUnreadable: Tests/UI/comptime_embed_bytes_missing.stderr.

Error: Jet.ComptimeFileUnreadable: `embed_bytes` can't open `does_not_exist.bin`
  --> Tests/UI/comptime_embed_bytes_missing.jet:1:12
    |
  1 | DATA: #run embed_bytes("does_not_exist.bin")
    |            ^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: No such file or directory (os error 2) (looked next to the file doing the embedding)
 Fix: Check the path — it is relative to the file's own directory
